evidence: Using a growth system capable of fast gas introduction and dimethylaluminum hydride (DMA1H) as the A1 source, we have observed one and two monolayer self-limiting growths of AlAs depending on the DMA1H supply and growth temperature. ... The source materials were supplied using a vent-and-run system which ensures automatic pressure control and a small dead-space manifold operated by a digital sequence controller. ... It has been confirmed that ALE growth of GaAs using trimethylgallium and arsine can be successfully achieved by this growth system.
